subject: Fixed incorrect menu showed on left click
body:
Fixed incorrect menu showed on left click

IC was taken from a tab that was not the actual tab, changed to TabHelper

triage.rationale: [Source](https://github.com/azet/mRemoteNG/commit/b1baa8910846e37ccb8bbfaca648e0925babeed9): Obsolete mRemoteV1 workaround uses potentially stale global TabHelper; current pane-local lookup also handles floating ActiveContent.
